八月中

九州创投上海分部像一台被人狠狠踹了一脚的引擎，嘶吼着转了起来。

震旦国际大楼二十四层，原本空荡荡的办公区现在塞满了人。工位排了三排，会议室白板上密密麻麻全是产业链图谱和项目编号，打印机从早响到晚，碎纸机也没停过。

张立恒说到做到。连续几天都出现在九洲创投办公室公司

早上九点整，他又拎着两个拉杆箱出现在前台。箱子里全是资料——东方科创港十六栋楼的租赁台账、企业名录、空置率月报、周边配套规划图、三年的财务流水。

“林总要的，全在这儿了。”他把箱子往会议桌上一放，拉链还没拉开，人先擦了把汗，“没挑，全带了。”

林川扫了一眼那个厚度，点了下头：“行，放这儿，我让人整理。”

张立恒走了之后，苏晚棠带着两个新招的研究员，花了整整三天才把这些数据全部拆完、归档、上图。

到第四天，一份完整的园区现状诊断报告已经摆在林川桌上。

但真正让上海办公室脱胎换骨的，是叶知秋。

闭门会第二天一早，她带着深圳总部策划组三个人、投研组两个人，一共六个人，拎着行李箱出现在震旦大楼楼下。

林川在门口接的。

叶知秋穿着件深蓝色衬衫，头发扎得利落，脸上带着没睡够的倦色，但眼神很亮。她一进门先没说话，绕着整个办公区走了一圈，看完工位布局、打印区、会议室、茶水间，然后回到林川面前。

“工位不够，至少再加八个。会议室得隔出一间小的，专门做内部碰头用。文件归档系统太乱，深圳的模板我带过来了，今天就换。”

林川靠在门框上，笑了一声：“你倒是不客气。”

“您让我来就是干活的，客气不了。”叶知秋已经开始往白板上写东西了。

苏晚棠从里面走出来，手里端着两杯咖啡，一杯递给叶知秋。

两个人对视了一下。

“晚棠，咱两就不说客气话了，本地资源对接和政府口子继续你来跑，内部流程和项目排期我接手，”叶知秋接过咖啡，喝了一口，“有冲突的地方随时喊我。”

苏晚棠点头：“行，你定节奏，我配合。”

林川看着这一幕，心里微微松了口气。叶知秋是他从深圳一路带出来的人，苏晚棠是上海本地能跑能扛的执行者，这两个人只要能配合起来，他就不用事事亲自盯了。

事实证明他没看错人。

叶知秋到的第一天下午，就把深圳总部的项目分级体系搬了过来，和苏晚棠一起把张立恒送来的园区数据重新洗了一遍。

第二天，上海分部的组织架构正式定下来——投研、法务、招商对接、行政，四个小组各配负责人，叶知秋统管协调，苏晚棠专攻外部资源。

第三天，第一批从深圳项目池里筛出来的十二个候选企业名单出炉，按行业、发展阶段、资金需求做了三级分类。

第四天，园区规划框架初稿成型。

第五天，陆承安打来电话。

“老林，上面已经看了你们的正式规划。”

电话那头语气很随意，但内容一点不随意。

“副市长和我爸都说了，由九州牵头往下推，经委这边全力配合。'”

林川坐在办公椅上，手指在桌面上轻轻敲了两下。

“替我谢谢陆局。”

“谢什么谢，东西是你自己做的，”陆承安笑了一声，“不过老林，你也别太拼了，我听说你们那个办公室灯就没熄过”

“快了，框架搭好就轻松了。”

挂掉电话，林川靠回椅背，长长吐了口气。

副市长点过头，经委正式放话让九州创投牵头。

这不是客气，是真金白银的入场券。

意味着张江那条线，从今天起，九州创投不再是“外来的建议者”，而是“官方认可的操盘手”。

从重生到现在，深圳起家、资本市场收割、腾讯入股、一路杀到上海——所有的铺垫，都在这一刻开始兑现。

林川没有太多时间感慨。他拿起手机，拨了顾城的号。

“忙完了？”顾城那边背景音很吵，像是在什么场子里。

“差不多。你明天来一趟公司。”

“干嘛？”

“园区配套服务平台这块，我准备单独拆出来做。企业入驻之后的财税、法务、人力资源、供应链对接，整合成一个一站式服务入口，”

林川语速不快，但每个字都砸实了，“这一块，你来盯。”

mid august

The Shanghai branch of Jiuzhou Venture Capital roared and started spinning like an engine that had been kicked hard.

On the twenty-fourth floor of the Aurora International Building, the originally empty office area is now filled with people.There are three rows of workstations. The whiteboard in the conference room is filled with industrial chain maps and project numbers. The printer rings from morning to night, and the shredder never stops.

Zhang Liheng does what he says.Appeared at Jiuzhou Venture Capital Office for several days in a row

At nine o'clock in the morning, he appeared at the front desk carrying two trolley cases.The box is full of information - the leasing ledgers of the sixteen buildings of Oriental Science and Technology Port, business directory, monthly vacancy rate report, surrounding supporting planning map, and three years of financial statements.

"Everything Mr. Lin wants is here." He put the box on the conference table. Before the zipper was unzipped, he wiped his sweat first, "I didn't pick anything, I brought it all."

Lin Chuan glanced at the thickness and nodded: "Okay, put it here and I'll have someone sort it out."

After Zhang Liheng left, Su Wantang and two newly recruited researchers took three full days to disassemble, archive and upload all the data.

By the fourth day, a complete diagnostic report on the current status of the park was on Lin Chuan’s desk.

But it was Ye Zhiqiu who really transformed the Shanghai office.

Early the next morning after the closed-door meeting, she appeared downstairs in the Aurora Building with three people from the Shenzhen headquarters planning team and two people from the investment research team, six people in total, carrying suitcases.

Lin Chuan picked him up at the door.

Ye Zhiqiu was wearing a dark blue shirt, his hair was neatly tied, and his face looked tired as if he hadn't slept enough, but his eyes were bright.She didn't say anything as soon as she entered the door. She walked around the entire office area, looking at the work layout, printing area, conference room, and tea room, and then returned to Lin Chuan.

"There are not enough workstations. We need to add at least eight more. We need to separate a small room in the conference room specifically for internal meetings. The file filing system is too messy. I brought the template from Shenzhen and will change it today."

Lin Chuan leaned against the door frame and smiled: "You're welcome."

"You asked me to come here just to do the work, so you're welcome." Ye Zhiqiu had already started writing on the whiteboard.

Su Wantang walked out of it, holding two cups of coffee in her hands, and handed one cup to Ye Zhiqiu.

The two people looked at each other.

"Wantang, let's stop talking politely. You will continue to handle local resource docking and government communication. I will take over the internal processes and project scheduling." Ye Zhiqiu took the coffee and took a sip. "If there is any conflict, call me anytime."

Su Wantang nodded: "Okay, you set the pace and I will cooperate."

Lin Chuan looked at this scene and felt slightly relieved.Ye Zhiqiu was the person he brought all the way from Shenzhen, and Su Wantang was a local executor in Shanghai who could run and carry. As long as these two people could cooperate, he wouldn't have to keep an eye on everything personally.

It turns out he was right.

On the afternoon of the first day he arrived, Ye Zhiqiu moved the project grading system from the Shenzhen headquarters, and together with Su Wantang, re-shuffled the park data sent by Zhang Liheng.

The next day, the organizational structure of the Shanghai branch was officially finalized - investment research, legal affairs, investment promotion, and administration. Each of the four groups was assigned a person in charge. Ye Zhiqiu was in charge of coordination, and Su Wantang specialized in external resources.

On the third day, the first list of twelve candidate companies screened from the Shenzhen project pool was released, classified into three levels according to industry, development stage, and capital needs.

On the fourth day, the first draft of the park planning framework was formed.

On the fifth day, Lu Chengan called.

"Old Lin, the higher-ups have seen your official plan."

The tone on the other end of the phone was casual, but the content was anything but casual.

"Both the deputy mayor and my dad have said that Jiuzhou will take the lead in pushing it down, and the Economic Commission will fully cooperate.'"

Lin Chuan sat on the office chair and tapped his fingers on the table twice.

"Thank you, Director Lu, for me."

"Thank you. You made the things yourself," Lu Chengan smiled, "But Lao Lin, don't try too hard. I heard that the lights in your office never went out."

"It's quick, it will be easy once the frame is set up."

After hanging up the phone, Lin Chuan leaned back in his chair and let out a long breath.

The deputy mayor nodded, and the Economic Committee officially let Jiuzhou Venture Capital take the lead.

This is not polite, it is a real money ticket.

This means that on the Zhangjiang line, from today on, Jiuzhou Venture Capital is no longer an "external proposer" but an "officially recognized trader."

From its rebirth to the present, starting in Shenzhen, harvesting the capital market, taking shares from Tencent, and all the way to Shanghai - all the foreshadowing is beginning to be fulfilled at this moment.

Lin Chuan didn't have much time to sigh.He picked up the phone and dialed Gu Cheng's number.

"Are you done?" The background sound from Gu Cheng's side was very noisy, as if he was in some kind of place.

"Almost. You come to the company tomorrow."

"What for?"

"I plan to separate the supporting service platform of the park separately. After the company settles in, the connection of finance, taxation, legal affairs, human resources, and supply chain will be integrated into a one-stop service entrance."

Lin Chuan didn't speak quickly, but he meant every word, "You keep an eye on this area."
